name: fretboard-js
description: A JavaScript plugin that renders a guitar fretboard as SVG. Use it to label notes, scales, use different tunings etc!

paragraphs: A dependency-free, plain-JavaScript plugin that renders a guitar fretboard as SVG and labels every note on it. No build step, no framework — drop in two files and call one constructor.
features: Two render modes: realistic (default) for the new instrument finish, or diagram for the original flat style.
In realistic mode: subtle SVG wood grain, a shaded surface and edge, metallic fret wires, layered strings, and clearer note markers with a ring around root notes.
Renders the full fretboard — nut, frets, strings, and standard dot inlays — as a single inline SVG.

Labels every fret with its actual note name, computed from the tuning you pass in (not hardcoded per-string offsets), so any tuning works correctly, including the guitar's one irregular interval between the G and B…
Any number of strings — the string count is always tuning.length, so ukulele, 4-string bass, and 8-string guitar all work the same way as standard 6-string guitar. See "Any number of strings" below.
